items.headline: Fortinet stock hits new all-time high amid AI-driven cybersecurity demand and bullish analyst sentiment
Fortinet expanded FortiEndpoint with new AI-era security capabilities, strengthening its endpoint and data security offering
Fortinet selects TD SYNNEX as global delivery and distribution partner to broaden channel reach
Zacks upgrades Fortinet to Rank #1 (Strong Buy), citing improving earnings expectations
Valuation-focused commentary flags Fortinet’s premium valuation as a potential headwind despite strong AI and cybersecurity catalysts
